title: Rosé Bungalow - 1.5 Miles to Broadway
description:
✨ Minutes from Broadway, walk to 12 South, and unwind at The Rosé Bungalow. This charming 2-bedroom Nashville retreat is just 1.5 miles from Broadway and less than a mile from the popular shops and restaurants of 12 South. Perfect for couples, families, business travelers, and extended stays, it features a fully equipped kitchen, inviting living spaces, and high-speed WiFi for a comfortable and convenient stay in the heart of Music City.

The space
Things You'll Love:
◆ Located heart of Nashville, less than a mile walk from 12 south
◆ Fully equipped kitchen with all of the essentials. 
◆ High-speed Wifi and workspace
◆ Central Heating & AC for year-round comfort.
◆ Smart TV – Log into your favorite streaming apps or cast from your phone.
◆ Access to a shared backyard (partially fenced) featuring a fire pit, hammock and gas grill
◆ Charming front porch. 
◆ Shared parking pad behind the home and ample street parking
◆ Dog Friendly - $150 pet fee per stay for up to 2 dogs. No breed or weight restrictions.

Sleeping Arrangements: 
◆ Bedroom 1 - King Bed + Smart TV + Desk 
◆ Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed + Smart TV + Desk 
◆ Living Room - Cozy couch + Queen Sized Air Mattress  + Smart TV

About Hallson Hospitality

At Hallson Hospitality, we take pride in being a locally owned company, offering a portfolio of thoughtfully designed properties that adhere to the highest standards of comfort and quality. Our team of hospitality professionals is dedicated to creating seamless and unforgettable experiences for each guest.

From curated amenities to personalized service, we go the extra mile to ensure your stay is exceptional. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your visit, please don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your time with us truly unforgettable. To further elevate your stay, we offer a variety of Experience Add-ons, including early check-ins and late check-outs, private chefs, in-home massages, in-home yoga sessions, and more.

Thank you for considering Rosé Bungalow for your upcoming trip! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper right-hand corner, so it’s easy to find again – whether for this trip or a future stay.

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible.

Other things to note
◆ The bungalow is part of a duplex, with this unit situated at the front facing the street.
◆ The shared backyard is not fully fenced, and there is no direct access to the backyard from the bungalow.
◆ While lovingly renovated, this older home retains its charming quirks.
◆ The interior design underwent a complete refresh in April 2024.
